data.body: 12 of the 14 failures are A1 follow-ups and are fixed on branch a1-win-followup (make verify running, then Gerrit): the 5 path-separator guard tests (commit under obtuse-phenocryst-verdin) and the 7 test_uv_pin_guard cases (commit under arctic-unsecular-esok). Both are test-only and render expected paths in POSIX form. The other 2, test_run_git_encodes_str_stdin_as_utf8, come from 04e175d70eb (livid-painful-mosquito), not A1, and are tracked by scholastic-travelsick-salmon (CRLF on text-mode stdin, confirmed by blob hash).
